content: {"phoneNote":"Clean, readable first screen with photo, headline and one CTA, but the price grid breaks into an uneven 2+1 layout and the hero photo is a generic desk stock mood.","desktopNote":"Hero and sections are tidy, but the 'Za koga delam' block leaves a huge empty right column under the text while the tall photo runs on, and the footer wordmark is oversized.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":2},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":2},"fixes":["Desktop 'Za koga delam': shorten the photo or add content so the right column isn't a dead band; on phone lay the three prices out as a single column or equal 3-up cards.","Replace the generic desk mood photos with something tied to tutoring (a worked problem, a student at a table) and drop the hero image so it sits higher on phone.","Scale down the footer wordmark on desktop and give the hero on desktop a tighter vertical rhythm so text doesn't float in the middle of the left column."],"blockers":[]}
